records.title: BIOPHARMA SHAKTI SCHEME
details:
Question asked by :-Shri Kesridevsinh
Jhala, Smt.
Seema Dwivedi,
Shri Narhari
Amin, Shri Brij
Lal, Shri
Shambhu Sharan
Patel, Dr.
Parmar
Jashvantsinh
Salamsinh, Smt.
Kiran Choudhry,
Shri
Mayankkumar
Nayak, Shri
Mithlesh Kumar,
Shri Narayana
Koragappa, Shri
Sadanand Mhalu
Shet Tanavade,
Shri Harsh
Mahajan
Assurance;-(a) to (d): With a view to
strengthen the domestic
biopharmaceutical sector and
enhance global
competitiveness in biologics
and biosimilars, the
Government has announced
the Biopharma SHAKTI
scheme with an outlay of
10,000 crore over five years
with an objective to build
globally competitive domestic
ecosystem for biologics and
biosimilars to support
affordable healthcare in India
and enable India to emerge
as a global biopharma
manufacturing and innovation
hub. The contours of the
scheme are under
deliberation.
